name: Weather
description: Generated fixture; no live data. Current conditions and hourly or daily forecast.
sizeRationale: Proposed gallery variants: small current temperature; medium current plus three forecast items; large five-item forecast and high/low. Current renderer uses one layout, 94 sp temperature and up to five forecast items; saved 2x2 resolves to 1x2.

states.label: Hourly forecast
states.headline: Weather
states.detail: Generated fixture; no live data. Example City · H: 24° · L: 16°. WIDGET_HOURLY renders up to five hour labels, condition icons and temperatures; anonymous example: Now 21°, 11 AM 22°, 12 PM 23°, 1 PM 24°, 2 PM 22°.

states.label: Daily forecast
states.headline: Weather
states.detail: Generated fixture; no live data. Example City · H: 24° · L: 16°. WIDGET_DAILY renders up to five days with condition icons and high/low: Today 24°/16°, Tue 23°/15°, Wed 22°/14°, Thu 24°/15°, Fri 25°/16°. These are generated examples, not a forecast.

states.label: Forecast strip off
states.headline: Weather
states.detail: Generated fixture; no live data. Example City · H: 24° · L: 16°. WIDGET_OFF hides only the hourly/daily strip; current weather remains, and high/low still appears if forecast.days has data. The renderer still runs its forecast producer.

states.label: Current conditions without forecast
states.headline: Weather
states.detail: Generated fixture; no live data. Example City. Current conditions are available but forecast is null: high/low and forecast items disappear. This also covers initial forecast loading or fetch failure; no dedicated forecast-error message or inline retry is rendered.

states.label: No location configured · proposed
states.headline: Choose a weather location
states.detail: Generated fixture; no live data. Proposed setup state. Current code has no separate location-setup branch; null data uses Weather unavailable.

states.label: Loading / shared placeholder
states.headline: Weather unavailable
states.detail: Generated fixture; no live data. Initial null current renders this same placeholder and weather icon. Loading is not distinguished from failure.

states.label: Unavailable / shared placeholder
states.headline: Weather unavailable
states.detail: Generated fixture; no live data. A failed current fetch uses this same null-data branch. There is no inline retry; forecast rows can disappear independently.

name: World clock
description: Generated fixture; no live data. Selected cities and their local time.
sizeRationale: Proposed gallery variants: small one city; medium two cities; large four cities with weekdays. Current code always takes the first four and uses the same scrolling digital layout; saved 2x2 resolves to 1x2.

states.label: Selected cities
states.headline: World clock
states.detail: Generated fixture; no live data. Example UTC city · Monday. Fixture time is fixed; production reads local time and selected zones.

states.label: No cities
states.headline: Add cities to see their local time.
states.detail: Generated fixture; no live data. Actual empty selection branch. No network or offline-error state applies.

name: Timers

sizeRationale: Proposed gallery variants: small countdown plus primary action; medium countdown with pause/reset; large presets and custom duration when ready. Current code uses one scrollable shell and FlowRow; saved 2x2 resolves to 1x2.

states.label: Running
states.headline: Set a timer
states.detail: Generated fixture; no live data. Actual running countdown branch; Pause and Reset are available.

states.label: Ready / no timer
states.headline: Set a timer
states.detail: Generated fixture; no live data. Actual zero-remaining, non-ringing branch offers 5m, 10m, 30m and Custom.

states.label: Paused
states.headline: Set a timer
states.detail: Generated fixture; no live data. Actual paused timer branch; Start and Reset are available.

states.label: Alarm ringing
states.headline: Stop the alarm
states.detail: Generated fixture; no live data. Actual ringing branch.

states.label: Upcoming events
states.headline: Calendar
states.detail: Generated fixture; no live data. Today · 10:30 AM. Anonymous event title; production uses grouped event rows.

states.label: No events
states.headline: No upcoming events
states.detail: Generated fixture; no live data. Actual configured feed with no rows and no error.

states.label: No calendar linked
states.headline: Add your calendar
states.detail: Generated fixture; no live data. See your upcoming events here. Actual missing-URL branch.

states.label: Loading
states.headline: Loading calendar…

states.label: Feed unavailable
states.headline: Calendar unavailable
states.detail: Generated fixture; no live data. Actual unavailable result without rows.

states.label: Saved events after failure

states.label: Refreshing saved content

states.detail: Generated fixture; no live data. Actual existing rows retained while refresh is in progress; the action is disabled.

name: Alarm
description: Generated fixture; no live data. Local wake-up time, repeat schedule and enabled state.
sizeRationale: Medium only: the current data model exposes one configured alarm, so smaller/larger density choices would not reveal another meaningful set of alarms or details. Keep its time, single label/countdown and enable control together. Current renderer uses one 48 sp time layout and scrollable shell; saved 2x2 resolves to 1x2. Multiple-alarm lists are not implemented.

states.label: Enabled
states.headline: Alarm
states.detail: Generated fixture; no live data. Example alarm · in 8 hr 30 min. Production shows cfg.label or the fallback Weekdays before the countdown, not both a label and a repeat summary. Next-trigger relative text has no continuous ticker. Disable denotes the existing inline toggle; it is not a literal text button.

states.label: Disabled
states.headline: No alarm set
states.detail: Generated fixture; no live data. Actual disabled branch still displays the configured time; No alarm set also appears when an enabled alarm has no next trigger. Enable denotes the inline toggle rather than a literal text button. No network/offline-error state is coded.

name: Quick controls
description: Generated fixture; no live data. Assistant, dashboard and companion-app launch shortcuts.
sizeRationale: Proposed gallery variants: small primary launch; medium two launches; large four launches. Current code always chunks in pairs with 150 dp minimum tiles; saved 2x1 resolves to 1x2. These are launchers, not direct entity controls.

states.label: Available shortcuts
states.headline: Quick controls
states.detail: Generated fixture; no live data. Actual HA companion labels all launch the same app. Generated discovery fixture; no installed-app information is read here.

states.label: Assistant only
states.headline: Quick controls
states.detail: Generated fixture; no live data. A generated discovery set has only launchable com.portal.assistant, no HA companion and no configured dashboard. The actual one-tile branch says Open your assistant and calls triggerJarvis, which uses JarvisHandoff.launch. No device inventory is read by the gallery.

states.label: Assistant handoff failure toast
states.headline: Jarvis couldn’t be opened.
states.detail: Generated fixture; no live data. Actual triggerJarvis fallback when JarvisHandoff.launch returns false. Production displays a long Toast; this fixture represents that message, not an implemented inline recovery panel or retry button.

states.label: No available companion
states.headline: Add an assistant or Home Assistant app to use quick controls.
states.detail: Generated fixture; no live data. Actual empty tile list also covers initial package discovery. Heading opens display settings; edit Settings opens quickbar.

states.label: Configured dashboard
states.headline: Quick controls
states.detail: Generated fixture; no live data. Actual configured-dashboard shortcut.

states.label: Inline app-launch failure recovery · proposed
states.headline: Couldn’t open app
states.detail: Generated fixture; no live data. Proposed generic inline failure/retry for app-launch shortcuts. The HA companion launch helper swallows runCatching failures; assistant handoff separately has the coded Jarvis failure toast represented by assistant_error. name: Photo memory
description: Generated fixture; no live data. Hero image from the selected source or photo-preview handoff.
sizeRationale: Proposed gallery variants: small cropped thumbnail; medium image with caption; large hero with caption. Current code crops the same image and keeps a fixed bottom overlay; saved 2x1 resolves to 2x4. Gallery must use generated art, never household photos.

states.label: Photo loaded
states.headline: Photo memory
states.detail: Generated fixture; no live data. Your selected photo source. With no configured active source, the loader decodes the bundled fallback JPEG and uses this same loaded-image caption. Generated artwork stands in for either image; no image URL or household image is included.

states.label: No bitmap / shared placeholder
states.headline: Photo memory
states.detail: Generated fixture; no live data. Open your photos. Actual non-web null-bitmap branch covers a selected source with no usable image, initial loading and failed access/decode/fetch. No configured source instead attempts the bundled fallback JPEG; it is not inherently an empty state, although this placeholder appears while that image loads or if decoding fails.

states.label: Web source selected
states.headline: Photo memory
states.detail: Generated fixture; no live data. Open your selected web page. Actual web-source handoff still launches PhotoFramePreviewActivity; there is no embedded live web preview or separate browser/deep-link API in this widget.

states.label: Source failure recovery · proposed
states.headline: Photos unavailable
states.detail: Generated fixture; no live data. Proposed distinct error/retry. Current code retains a same-source bitmap on refresh failure without stale status; otherwise shows Open your photos.

name: Android app widget
description: Generated fixture; no live data. Hosted installed Android provider category, not a fifteenth custom kind.
sizeRationale: Medium is a category preview only. Actual allowed dimensions and resize capabilities depend on the installed provider; the gallery does not promise small/medium/large provider variants. Current host estimates initial spans from provider minimum dp /128, clamped to 2–4, honors explicit spans and reports actual cell dimensions through AppWidget options. This host path does not enforce provider resizeMode or minResize dimensions.

states.label: Provider hosted
states.headline: Android app widget
states.detail: Generated fixture; no live data. Generated provider shell only. Production RemoteViews content and its states belong to the installed provider; implemented describes the hosting path, not these fictional provider contents. Widget settings is the existing edit-mode action, not a universal button inside provider content.

states.label: No installed providers
states.headline: No app widgets installed.
states.detail: Generated fixture; no live data. Actual provider-library empty branch, with library Refresh action; this is not an empty RemoteViews content state.

states.label: Discovering providers
states.headline: Loading installed app widgets…
states.detail: Generated fixture; no live data. Actual provider-library null inventory branch when no provider cards are available; this is not a provider-content loading state.

states.label: Provider unavailable
states.headline: Widget unavailable
states.detail: Generated fixture; no live data. Actual host AppWidgetInfo-null branch. Label is anonymous; no installed package identity is exposed.

states.label: Settings launch failure
states.headline: Widget settings couldn’t be opened.
states.detail: Generated fixture; no live data. Actual edit Settings launch-failure toast, represented here as a fixture; production uses a transient toast, not an inline provider panel or configuration-result error.
